name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not ensure the box is held at the exit; it only requires holding_box at or after each fall. Add hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) to capture “carry the box to the exit.”

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not require pickup afterward; it also allows holding_box to be true on the same step as box_fell. The task says to pick the box up again after each fall. Use `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` to require it on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require pickup again after each fall; it allows holding_box to be true before the fall and remain true through it. The task requires a pickup after every fall. Replace it with ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which requires holding the box on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is picked up again after it falls. It allows `holding_box` to be true before the fall, with no later pickup. The task requires pickup afterward; use `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` to require it on the very next step.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up after every fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Carry the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again.
machine:

(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3

(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
